in_hebrew.name: קטרינה
in_hebrew.long_meaning: השם קטרינה מקורו בשם העברי קתרינה, שפירושו טוהר, ניקיון ושלמות באמונה. הוא נגזר מהמילה 'קתרוס', שפירושו טוהר, ומהמילה 'קטרינה', שפירושו השלמה או השלם. השם קטרינה הוא מקורו של השם היווני Αἰκατερίνη, שפירושו טוהר.

in_greek.name: Αἰκατερίνη
in_greek.long_meaning: Τὸ ὄνομα Αἰκατερίνη προέρχεται ἀπὸ τὸ ἑβραϊκὸ ὄνομα קטרינה, ποὺ σημαίνει τὸ καθαρόν καὶ ἄγion. Ἡ λέξις Αἰκατερίνη εἶναι σύνθετη λέξις ἀπὸ τὸ 'αἰκός', ποὺ σημαίνει καθαρότητα, καὶ τὸ 'κατερίνη', ποὺ σημαίνει ἡ ἀκέραιος ἢ ἡ τέλεια. Τὸ ὄνομα αὐτὸ ἦταν πολὺ δημοφιλὲς στὴν ἀρχαία Ἐκκλησία λόγῳ τῆς ἁγίας Αἰκατερίνης τῆς Ἀλεξανδρινῆς.

in_latin.name: Caterina
in_latin.long_meaning: Nomen Caterina originem habet in nomine hebraico קטרינה, quod significat puritas et integritas. Vox Caterina derivata est a voce 'katharos', quod significat purus, et a voce 'katerine', quod significat integer vel perfectus. Nomen hoc in Ecclesia primitiva valde usitatum erat propter sanctam Caterinam Alexandrinam.

in_english.name: Katrina
in_english.meaning: Pure, clear, and whole in faith
in_english.long_meaning: The name Katrina originates from the Hebrew name קטרינה (Katerinah), meaning pure, clear, and whole in faith. It is derived from the Hebrew word 'katharos', meaning pure, and 'katerinah', meaning completeness or wholeness. The name gained popularity in the Christian tradition due to Saint Catherine of Alexandria, a 4th-century martyr and saint. Katrina symbolizes purity, innocence, and devotion, reflecting the spiritual values of Christianity.

saint_reference.note: A 4th-century martyr and saint, known for her faith and wisdom.

data.cultural_impact: Katrina is a popular given name in many countries, including the United States. It has been particularly significant in the Southern United States, where it was commonly used in the 19th and 20th centuries. The name Katrina gained renewed fame in 2005 when Hurricane Katrina hit the Gulf Coast, causing widespread devastation and garnering international attention. The storm's name, which was only assigned after the fact, served as a somber reminder of the destruction wrought by the natural disaster.
data.spiritual_significance: In Christianity, Katrina is a name associated with purity, clarity, and, through the patronage of Saint Catherine of Alexandria, a connection to the divine wisdom and protection of the Blessed Mother and the Holy Spirit. For those named Katrina, or for anyone who associates with this name, it carries a spiritual significance that inspires a commitment to living a pure and clear life, and to seeking wisdom and guidance in times of need. It also reminds us of the power and mystery of the natural world, and of the importance of respecting and caring for the earth and all of its inhabitants.
